experience.description: Delivered end-to-end technical support across hardware, software, and network environments. Diagnosed and resolved system faults, performed workstation imaging, managed Active Directory accounts, and maintained documentation for recurring incidents.

Conducted lab-based research covering topics including network enumeration, vulnerability scanning, secure configuration hardening, and incident response procedures. Applied findings through structured assignments and documented lab reports.

Maintained lab infrastructure, assisted instructors with environment setup, and provided peer support for students working with networking and OS-level coursework. Managed software licensing and system restore points.
